subject.title: [Bug]: Taglines can trigger accidental shell interpolation in ZSH environments

question: Should maintainers require a concrete zsh transcript before changing CLI tagline copy or escaping behavior for this report?
rationale: The report names `shellCommandPrefix`, but current main renders the banner through direct stdout output and no live zsh reproduction is available in this review.

options.title: Wait for zsh proof
options.body: Ask for the exact command, zsh options, OpenClaw version, and observed output before accepting a code change.

options.title: Preemptively sanitize taglines
options.body: Remove or escape shell-looking punctuation from the tagline pool even without a reproduced shell-evaluation path.

recommendation.title: Wait for zsh proof
recommendation.body: Ask for the exact command, zsh options, OpenClaw version, and observed output before accepting a code change.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the CLI tagline surface and the config mode that controls it.
